[FRAMEWORK] QM_EntryRequest req at line 415 is not passed through ZeroMemory, and Strategy_EntrySignal does not assign expiration_seconds, leaving request state indeterminate.

[CARD-FIDELITY] The approved card requires 50% at T1, the remaining 50% at T2, and ATR trailing after T1. The EA places a full-position T1 broker target only; it has no QM_TM_PartialClose, T2 target, or post-T1 trail state.

[CARD-FIDELITY] The approved card requires an opposite-direction Alternate-Bat to close the current position before reversal. Strategy_ExitSignal always returns false, OnTick never invokes it, and Strategy_ManageOpenPosition implements only the time stop.
